title: Song selection on Music › Songs works for Spotify likes
acceptance: At an emulated phone width (390 or narrower), the RF-151 checkboxes, 15-song cap, selection bar and "Create a class" sheet work for Spotify likes as they do for Apple Music and SoundCloud.
Ticking Spotify songs and then switching to another provider clears the selection, and switching back to Spotify starts empty.
A component or e2e test covers the Spotify likes list in pick mode with the mock provider.
nextAction: Rescoped on 2026-11-01 (owner: "Yes rescope", given in the Air session and relayed by the Air) to the three checks that remain now that Spotify likes reach pick mode on production (desktop check, 2026-10-31): Spotify at phone width, tick then switch provider, and a mock-provider test. No longer waits on RF-92; still starts after RF-151 is Done. No parent on purpose: an open child would block RF-151 from Done. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #667, item 1: RF-151 depending on RF-92 would block its Apple and SoundCloud work.

On production 67496ab (RF-151 pick mode), the Neo's desktop Chrome check in the owner's signed-in browser listed Spotify liked songs on Music › Songs and selection worked on them; nothing was saved. So Spotify likes already reach the pick-mode list; whether this record still needs work, and whether it still waits on RF-92, is for the owner to decide.
